record.context_brief: maximal type at fixed edim and multiplicity
record.original_question: For integers e and m with 3 <= e < m, let T(e,m) be the supremum of t(Gamma) over all numerical semigroups Gamma with embedding dimension edim(Gamma) = e + 1 and multiplicity mult(Gamma) = m, where t(Gamma) is the type of Gamma, namely the number of pseudo-Frobenius numbers of Gamma. Determine T(e,m).

evidence.quote: Problem 5. Determine T (e,m) = sup{ t(Γ ) | edim(Γ ) = e+1, mult(Γ ) = m }.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a recent collection of open problems on numerical semigroups (Moscariello–Sammartano, 2024). A web search did not surface any subsequent paper announcing a determination of T(e,m) for the full range 3 ≤ e < m, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on relations of numerical semigroups (arXiv:2406.00790)
status_evidence.snippet: The paper collects open problems about minimal presentations of numerical semigroups, including a problem asking to determine T(e,m).
status_evidence.claim: T(e,m) is explicitly listed as an open problem.
